# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in this project!

**This project does not accept code contributions.** It is source-available for viewing purposes only — all rights reserved (see [LICENSE](../LICENSE)). Pull requests are disabled and any code submission will not be reviewed or merged.

## How you can help

- 🐛 **Found a bug?** Open an [Issue](../../issues) describing what happened, what you expected, and how to reproduce it.
- 💡 **Have an idea or suggestion?** Start a thread in [Discussions](../../discussions).

That's it — reports and suggestions are genuinely appreciated, and every issue gets read.
